title: canary-release-planning-notes-olivia-hart
content:
Notes / scratchpad for next canary: target model-server v1.12.3 + runtime kernel update

Context:
- Reason: kernel-level perf fix for KV cache invalidation (fixes tokenization stall on long-context workloads). Needs canary before Dedicated release.
- Target envs: hosted-us-west (primary), hosted-eu (follow after green), dedicated pools TBD.
- Owner (me): Olivia Hart. Oncall for the rollout window: Jordan Lee (SRE primary), Maya Singh (runtime), Samir Patel (serving).

High-level plan (quick):
- Stage 0: smoke deploy to staging + run sanity suite (2 hours)
- Stage 1: 1% traffic canary in us-west for 60m (monitor SLOs + perf diffs)
- Stage 2: 5% traffic for 120m if green
- Stage 3: 20% traffic for 180m, enable auto-rollback triggers
- Stage 4: 50% for 60m then 100% if no regressions

Detailed checklist (working):
- Prep:
  - [ ] Build image tag: redwood/inference:v1.12.3-canary-olivia-20260212
  - [ ] Confirm feature flags: kv-cache-fix=true, legacy-kernel=false
  - [ ] Pin model versions: llama-2-13b-v2@rev-20260201 (store rollout mapping)
  - [ ] Update rollout config in router: route-group canary-olivia with weights
  - [ ] Add deployment note to CHANGELOG + Slack #releases thread

- Tests to run pre-canary:
  - quick-inference-smoke (all models) \u0014 pass
  - long-context-regression (10k tokens) \u0014 pay attention to stall metrics
  - throughput/load-10k (short bursts) \u0014 confirm no tps drop-off
  - canary-eval-promptset (select 50 prompts) \u0014 check quality/regression alerts

Monitoring and success criteria:
- Error rate: no >0.5% increase over baseline at each stage
- Latency p95: no >10% increase; if p95 decreases that's expected but check p99 for tail regressions
- Token drop/retry: zero tolerance >1/min sustained \u0014 immediate rollback
- KV cache hits: measure + expected increase (should improve for long-context)
- Downstream logs: search for serialization errors / OOMs
- Cost: track cost-per-token delta (note: quantization may change behavior)

Rollback triggers (auto + manual):
- Auto-rollback: if error rate spike >1% absolute for 5 minutes or continuous p99 increase >20% vs baseline for 10 minutes
- Manual rollback: any new class of errors (serialization, crashloop), or customer escalation in top-10 accounts
- Runbook: see linked Confluence page -> follow 'Rollback and Postmortem' steps

Region/traffic routing notes:
- Start only in us-west to minimize blast radius
- If green after 24h, mirror rollout to eu with same staged percentages
- Dedicated customers: do NOT route unless explicit invite (will require dedicated pool deploy and schedule)

Version pinning details:
- For this canary, pin models in config: llama-2-13b -> rev-20260201 (explicit SHA in repo).
- Document mapping in /configs/rollouts/canary-olivia-20260212.yaml (ops will write).
- If a rollback occurs, ensure we restore both runtime image AND model revision; rollback script should read previous mapping from rollout metadata.

Config toggles and safety nets:
- Toggle kv-cache-fix via runtime flag (controlled by config store) \u0014 can be toggled without full restart for some nodes
- Legacy-kernel fallback: router supports model-variant fallback to v1.11.x-kernel if severe perf regression observed; ensure fallback policy enabled for canary route-group
- Circuit breaker: global per-model QPS cap for canary route-group set to baseline * 1.5

Observability and dashboards:
- Dashboards to watch: \"Canary: latency/error by route\", \"KV cache stats by pod\", \"Long-context stalls\"
- Alerting: temporary alert thresholds set for this canary (managed in Alertmanager): low-sev p95 increase, high-sev error spikes -> page SRE
- Add an evaluators tab for canary promptset diffs (Maya will push results)

Communication plan:
- Pre-deploy note in #releases + #sre 1h before Stage 1
- Short status pings at each stage milestone in Slack (Jordan to post)
- If rollback: immediate @oncall + create incident in Incident Tracker + postmortem owner assigned (me)

Open questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- Who needs access to the canary route-group in Console? Add Samir and Maya today.
- Confirm dedicated pool capacity if we decide to invite one customer for early validation.
- Need to add smoke test for function-calling workflows (edge-case).
- Confirm if A/B evaluation for quality requires model-compare snapshot (talk to ML evals).

Post-rollout follow-ups:
- If successful, schedule Dedicated release cut (coordinate with sales for any customers affected)
- Add perf regression tests to CI to catch similar issues earlier
- Draft short postmortem with perf graphs and decisions

Quick timeline draft (subject to change):
- 2026-02-26: staging smoke + canary image bake
- 2026-02-27: Stage 1 -> 1%
- 2026-02-27: Stage 2 -> 5% (afternoon)
- 2026-02-28: Stage 3 -> 20%
- 2026-03-01: Stage 4 -> 50% -> 100% next day if green

Misc notes:
- Keep an eye on costs \u0014 higher KV caching may increase memory usage; coordinate with infra for capacity headroom.
- If we see improved latency, update perf docs and talk with Product about bumping default for hosted customers.

End of scratchpad. Will iterate with Jordan/Maya/Samir and convert to a formal runbook once checks pass.
